   outside the condition's context.  Waiting callers are notified even

   If both are supplied, the condition must use the supplied lock as its
   underlying lock.  A lock alone protects the cache but does not prevent
   concurrent computations for the same key.  Avoid recursive calls with
   the same key when using a condition, since they would wait on themselves.
